sections.heading: Unique Opportunities
sections.markdown:
- 130 video monitors located in MCCS facilities—the largest number of digital assets on any military base west of the Mississippi.
- 7 Roadside Gate Marquees with 8.5 million vehicles annually.
- Large Format Wall Wrap options available around the base.

**85,000** Average Daily Population

**43,000** Active-Duty Military

**36,000** Spouses and Children

sections.heading: Camp Pendleton Demographics
sections.markdown:
- 195 square miles
- 17 miles of coastline
- 8,400,000 Camp Pendleton vehicles at 7 entry gates annually (Billboards and Marquees located by gates)
- 5,000,000 Fitness Center visitors annually (13 centers)
- 235,000 Single Marine Program Centers visitors annually (8 centers)
- 86% of Active Duty Marines aboard Camp Pendleton are male

sections.heading: Important Information
sections.markdown:
- Every dollar invested in Advertising and Sponsorship goes towards Quality-of Life programs aboard Camp Pendleton
- Both Digital and Print options are available to help meet your business needs.
- A Commercial Sponsorship Agreement (CSA) is a required document that is signed by both MCCS and the Advertiser/Sponsor, outlining the details of the Advertising/Sponsorship agreement.
- There is a $1,500 minimum for each new Commercial Sponsorship Agreement.
- At least a 4-week lead time is needed to execute any new campaign and Agreement.
- All artwork must be approved prior to any printing or running digitally on any MCCS assets.
- All Advertising must contain the disclaimer: "_No Department of Defense, U.S. Marine Corps or Marine Corps Community Services endorsement implied._"
